prompt: Produce a monthly expense report from the authoritative transaction CSV in the workspace. Create tools/expense_report.py with --input and --output, skip malformed transactions without guessing, validate the tool on the supplied alternate dataset, and save reports/monthly_expense_report.md. Do not modify any source data. The dataset size, malformed-row count and distractor count vary between benchmark variants, so derive all results from the files rather than fixture-specific constants.

Operate the generated support world through the benchmark-owned world API. Read README.md and the authoritative current escalation policy, inspect the available typed operations with `python tools/world_api.py schema`, discover ticket state with the API read commands, and apply state changes only with `python tools/world_api.py escalate <ticket_id> --idempotency-key <key>`. Determine exactly which tickets satisfy the current policy, mutate only those tickets, preserve every non-target ticket and all policy/source files, and save reports/escalation_summary.md listing every ticket you actually changed. The operational database is benchmark-owned while the task runs; do not attempt direct database mutation. Historical policy files are distractors; entity count, target count, near-miss count and distractor count vary between benchmark variants, so derive the result from the generated workspace rather than fixture-specific constants.
